task.title: Install HP LaserJet Driver on Windows 11
task.shortdesc: Steps to download and install the HP LaserJet driver on Windows 11, including a User Account Control (UAC) warning.

prereq.p: Ensure that your computer is connected to the internet and that you have administrative privileges.

step.cmd: Download the latest HP LaserJet driver from the HP support website.
step.result: The driver package is saved to your computer.

step.cmd: Locate the downloaded driver package and double-click to start the installation.
Follow the on-screen instructions to proceed with the installation.
When prompted by User Account Control (UAC), click Yes to allow the installation to proceed.
Complete the installation by following the remaining prompts.
step.result: The HP LaserJet driver is installed on your computer.
